cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're on stage two of reconciliation. Choose a biscuit. You always did learn better with something to chew.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Getting you to ask about the process. I taught you to ask questions; nice to see one at last.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good honesty. Stage two is already working. Take the biscuit; I used to have to coax a straight answer out of you.
